purpose: A task set for selective-risk measurement of the unified model's front door. Half the tasks must be answered by a specific engine; half must be refused. The refusal class is the point: a system that answers everything has no measurable risk-coverage trade-off.

provenance.source: Authored 2026-11-26 from the frontier routing contract in canonical/tests/test_frontier_routing_contract_v1.py plus the verifier's UNKNOWN_GOALS. NOT mined from post-cutoff repositories.
provenance.honest_limit: These tasks are hand-authored by the same session that wired the routes. They measure whether the contract holds, not whether Brain generalises to unseen work. A genuine frontier score requires post-cutoff mined tasks; this set deliberately records that it is not one, and the evaluator refuses to emit a headline for it.
